sentences.text: Hollanda is known only from partial hind limbs that feature long legs and an unusual toe configuration.
Fossils of Hollanda were found at Khermeen Tsav and date to about 75 million years ago during the Campanian stage of the late Cretaceous.
The species was named by Alyssa Bell after the Holland family, who donated to the project, and the rock band Lucero.
Hollanda is classified within the parent group Ornithuromorpha.
Hollanda is classified under the class Reptilia.
The time range for Hollanda is estimated from 83.6 to 72.2 million years ago.
There is debate regarding Hollanda's classification, with studies placing it in the Ornithurae, the primitive family Songlingornithidae, the family Gansuidae, or as an enantiornithean.
